guard.note: listResources: ZipFile.entries(), then vanilla's filter loop (isDirectory, startsWith type/namespace/path/, tryBuild, accept or warn) that the index feeds NeoForge 21.1.252 production variant: instruction/control-flow equivalence verified; only compiler layout, local slots and named synthetic capture fields differ.
getOrCreateZipFile: one ZipFile object until close(); the index is tied to that object

vanilla_zip_pack_listing_index.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation (priority 1500, require = 0) on the ZipFile.entries() call in FilePackResources.listResources (listResources): after the original call (a closed ZipFile still throws), the enumeration of the bucket type/namespace/path/ (entry name up to its third '/') from a per-ZipFile index built in one walk (central-directory order, directories and names with fewer than three '/' left out); vanilla's filter loop runs unchanged on it. Helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_zip_index.ZipListings (index, two fields added by the mixin: the index and its lock); Neighbours steps aside for ModernFix's BETA FilePackResourcesMixin and for any untested foreign mixin on FilePackResources. Shadow mode -Dbons_and_furious.zipPackListingIndex.shadow=true.
vanilla_zip_pack_listing_index.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixin replaces only the enumeration vanilla's own loop walks, with our own index (helpers bons.furious.patch.vanilla_zip_index.ZipListings and Neighbours)
